home.intro: I build for the web, tinker with embedded systems, and keep finding my way back to Rust. Learning Nix, too. This is where the different threads meet.
home.footnote: Some finished things. Some open questions. All part of learning.
home.aboutBody: I’m a university student from Homs, Syria. I like understanding the layers beneath a tool, and making something useful with what I find. Rust has become a particular favorite.
home.helloBody: Send a cool link, compare notes, or just say hello.
